description: React component for an interactive flow canvas in an agent/chatflow editor, utilizing reactflow library, managing nodes and edges, handling user interactions, API calls, and UI controls.

methods.name: onConnect
methods.description: Handles creation of new edges between nodes, with validation and styling based on node types.

methods.name: handleLoadFlow
methods.description: Loads flow data from JSON string into nodes and edges state.

methods.name: handleDeleteFlow
methods.description: Confirms and deletes the current chatflow, navigating away on success.

methods.name: handleSaveFlow
methods.description: Serializes current flow and saves as new or updates existing chatflow via API.

methods.name: onNodeClick
methods.description: Selects a node and updates its visual state.

methods.name: onNodeDoubleClick
methods.description: Opens node editing dialog unless node is a sticky note.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles dropping new nodes onto the canvas, with validation for node types and placement.

methods.name: syncNodes
methods.description: Synchronizes local nodes with component nodes, updating outdated data.

methods.name: saveChatflowSuccess
methods.description: Displays success snackbar after saving chatflow.

methods.name: setDirty
methods.description: Marks the flow as having unsaved changes.

methods.name: checkIfSyncNodesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if local nodes are outdated compared to component nodes, enabling sync button.
